_help: Guide bubbles for the tutorial level. Each step waits for its 'done' event, then the next step shows. target: what to sparkle (a hotspot key). Events: clue_seen:<id>, lock_opened:<id>, item_picked:<id>, combined, level_complete.

steps.text: Good morning, Juliette. Mamie Céline left you one last treasure hunt. Tap things in the room to take a closer look. Start with the note on the coffee table.
Mamie's riddle gives 7, 1 and 4. Close the note, tap the credenza drawers and enter 7 1 4.
Something's inside. Tap the batteries to put them in your bag (at the bottom of the screen).
There's a flashlight on the bookshelf. Tap it to pick it up too.
Let's combine them! In your bag, tap the flashlight, then tap the batteries. (You can also drag one onto the other.)
A working flashlight! It's too dark under the armchair cushion... Tap the flashlight in your bag, then tap the armchair.
You found a key! Pick it up.
Last step: tap the key in your bag, then tap the balcony door. The sun is almost up! (Stuck any time? Mamie's notebook in the top corner gives hints.)
